data.gender_notes: Haffaz is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: In Arabic, Haffaz means 'guardian' or 'protector'. This name holds a significant place in Islamic history, where Prophet Muhammad (pbuh) is known to have used this title for those entrusted with the protection and preservation of the Quran and Islamic teachings. The name Haffaz carries the meaning “Guardian, Protector” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Haffaz usually hope their child will grow to embody guardian, protector and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: To be a guardian and protector of knowledge and wisdom.
data.etymology: Haffaz belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Guardian, Protector.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Haffaz total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.

in_english.name: Haffaz
in_english.meaning: One who remembers and protects, Quran memorizer
in_english.long_meaning: Haffaz is derived from the Arabic root 'ح-ف-ظ' which means to preserve, protect, or memorize. In Islamic tradition, Haffaz refers to one who has memorized the Quran or has a strong memory and preserves knowledge. The term 'Hafiz' is often used interchangeably, signifying a guardian or protector of sacred knowledge. Historically, Hafiz (Haffaz) was also a companion of the Prophet Muhammad and a renowned scholar. The name symbolizes wisdom, spiritual insight, and a strong connection to Islamic heritage and learning.
